sources.summary: Casa Lego unfolds as an encounter between nature, light, and architecture across its 1,390 m². Designed by architect Fernanda Marques, the project was born from a family’s desire to live in an urban, cosmopolitan São Paulo without giving up the feeling of being surrounded by greenery, light, and silence.
